description: Na₅Al₃F₁₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mnc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 33°. There are four shorter (1.79 Å) and two longer (1.80 Å) Al-F bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 33°. There are four shorter (1.79 Å) and two longer (1.82 Å) Al-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four equivalent Na and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Al atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Al atom.
